title: .gitignore's unanchored coverage.* pattern can silently untrack source files
description:
The coverage.* ignore pattern (meant for Go coverage artifacts at the repo root) has no leading slash, so it matches at every depth: a source file named coverage.go in any package is silently untracked while local tests stay green. This tick's first two make gate runs passed on a working tree whose HEAD could not compile (internal/gatewaytrace/coverage.go existed only on disk); it was caught by diffing the branch against the base and fixed by renaming to attribution.go. Anchoring the pattern (/coverage.*) or narrowing it to the artifact extensions would remove the trap.
evidence: .gitignore:15; the near-miss is commit 759e8c339's message
